title: Age Discrimination in Employment Act of 1967 — Statute profile
subject: Age Discrimination in Employment Act of 1967
summary: Age Discrimination in Employment Act of 1967 is a statute of United States enacted in 1967, in the area of employment. Protects workers age 40 and older from age discrimination. It is formally cited as Pub. L. 90-202.
key_points: Core effect: Protects workers age 40 and older from age discrimination.
guidance: General information only, not legal advice. Use the citation to look up the current official text; statutes are amended over time.
